question: A concave lens of focal length 30 cm forms an image of an object placed at 60 cm from it. The position and nature of the image formed will be:
solution:
The correct answer is** -__20 cm, virtual and erect__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Given:**

 
 
• **Focal length of concave lens (f) **= -30 cm (Focal length of a concave lens is always negative)
 
• **Object distance (u) **= -60 cm (Object distance is always negative)
 
 
 
• **Using the lens formula:**
 
 
• 1/f = 1/v - 1/u
 
• **Where:**
 
• f = focal length
 
• v = image distance
 
• u = object distance
 
 
 
• **Substituting the given values:**
 
 
• 1/(-30) = 1/v - 1/(-60)
 
• -1/30 = 1/v + 1/60
 
• 1/v = -1/30 - 1/60
 
• 1/v = (-2 - 1)/60
 
• 1/v = -3/60
 
• 1/v = -1/20
 
• v = -20 cm
 
 
 
• **The negative sign of v indicates that the image is formed on the same side as the object.**
 
• **Since it's a concave lens, the image formed is virtual and erect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Difference between Concave and Convex Lens**

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Concave Lens
 Convex Lens
 
 

 The light is spread out by a diverging lens.
 The refracted rays are converged by a converging lens.
 
 

 Thinner in the centre than at the edges.
 Thicker in the centre than at the edges.
 
 

 The image is on one side of the lens, while the object is on the other.
 The object and the image are both on the same side of the lens.
 
 

 The focal length is positive.
 The focal length is negative.
 
 

 The image will be erect, virtual, and diminished.
 The resultant image will be both real and inverted.
 
 

 Eyeglasses for myopia (nearsightedness)
 Eyeglasses for hyperopia (farsightedness), magnifying glasses
 
 

 Applications include correcting nearsightedness, creating virtual images
 Applications include correcting farsightedness, magnification, projectors
